instruction: A candid wedding photograph, medium shot. At an outdoor wedding venue at night, the groom in the white embroidered sherwani (R1) stands on the left, facing slightly right with a gentle smile. Beside him, the bride in the red bridal lehenga (R2) stands on the right, looking forward with a happy expression. She rests her left hand on his shoulder and holds his arm with her right hand. The background is softly out of focus, showing warm decorative lights and structures. The lighting is warm and festive, casting a soft glow on the couple.
